title: Human Capital in Context: What Employment Survival Reveals About Worker-Firm Match
abstract: arXiv:2611.16058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There is no best worker in general, only a best worker for a particular firm. We develop a measure of worker-firm match quality that treats fit as a property of the pair, learned from the survival of employment relationships. A two-tower neural network embeds workers, from their career histories and current positions, and firms, from their characteristics and business descriptions, into a common space, and match quality is the cosine similarity of the two vectors. The measure takes its functional form from the skill-weights model of firm-specific human capital, and its only estimated objective, a separation hazard, from the view of the job match as an experience good. Estimated on more than a billion person-periods covering 101 million workers and 8.4 million firms, a 0.1 increase in match quality lowers the odds of separation by 48%. translated_title: 情境中的人力资本：就业存续揭示了怎样的劳动者-企业匹配信息
translated_abstract: 总体上不存在最好的劳动者，只存在对特定企业而言最好的劳动者。我们开发了一种劳动者-企业匹配质量的度量方法，将匹配视为配对本身的属性，并从雇佣关系的存续中学习得到。一个双塔神经网络将劳动者（依据其职业履历和当前职位）与企业（依据其特征和业务描述）嵌入到一个共同空间中，匹配质量即为两个向量的余弦相似度。该度量的函数形式源自企业专用人力资本的技能权重模型，其唯一的估计目标——离职风险率——则源于将工作匹配视为体验品的观点。基于覆盖1.01亿劳动者和840万家企业的超过十亿人-期数据估计，匹配质量提高0.1可使离职几率降低48%。匹配质量方差中约有四分之一是劳动者-企业配对所特有的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于双塔神经网络、从雇佣关系存续（离职风险）中学习的劳动者-企业匹配质量度量方法，发现匹配质量提高0.1可使离职几率降低48%，且约四分之一的匹配质量方差为特定配对所独有。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a two-tower neural network measure of worker-firm match quality learned from employment survival (a separation hazard), showing that a 0.1 increase in match quality lowers separation odds by 48%, with about a quarter of match quality variance specific to the worker-firm pair.
